The '''Aratech S15 Speeder Bike''' was a model of [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] manufactured by the [[Aratech Repulsor Company]] during the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="Bundle" /> 
{{Veh-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The S15 first appeared during the [[2022]] [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith|''Legacy of the Sith'']] expansion for [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''<ref name="Bundle" /> where it was made available to both Republic and Empire players as part of the "Enter The Fight" Bundle, released through the game's online store on [[October 14]], [[2025]].<ref name="Store">{{TORweb|url=buy|text=Store}}</ref>
